items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Mr. Matoya; the interviewer identifies him in a photo ('right behind Mr. Matoya is a tuba').

ctx.x: This one says Mitchell Grove, Sunday, August the 4th, 1907. There he is again, right here, in a different uniform.

Oh, yes. That's the small brass band. That's the old generation. And he's down here on the kneeling almost, or sitting on the ground, I guess. Sitting on the ground. This is it. With a big bass drum with a rope. And the snare drum. And right behind Mr. Matoya is a tuba. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven. Only an eight-piece band. I guess two carnets and tuba and trombone. Two drums, alto horn. Oh, that's a baritone there. There. There's the tuba. That's all they had.
And how many do they have in this one?
